::: notes
The reading for this session is the page SCORE on the workshop's website. It tells the story of SCORE and its robustness study at greater length, with the quotations from the preregistration and a table of the case studies, and its section on the robustness study covers the article that reported it: the common scale, the rules of the conversion, what they assume, and the questions to put to any effect size converted for a comparison of this kind. The next session turns to the infrastructure that made all of these findings checkable, where data come from and on what terms, and where the materials and the plans of a study are kept, and every record that we used in this session sits in one of those places.
:::
